name: 2048 GB
author: Sanqui (game), tiles by beware; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: 2048 for the original Game Boy by Sanqui: slide the tiles, merge equal numbers, reach 2048. Runs on the built-in Game Boy emulator (Peanut-GB) with touch controls and gamepads; the high score is saved. zlib license (github.com/Sanqui/2048-gb).

descriptions.it: 2048 per il Game Boy originale, di Sanqui: fai scorrere le tessere, unisci i numeri uguali, arriva a 2048. Gira sull'emulatore Game Boy integrato (Peanut-GB) con comandi touch e gamepad; il record viene salvato. Licenza zlib (github.com/Sanqui/2048-gb).
